scientific_integrity: An exact finite-graph theorem proved using a reproducible integer-arithmetic enumeration and an analytic incidence-rank argument; independently validated priority is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous classical Ising spins on the 30-vertex icosidodecahedron, J>0, strict interior field 0<h<4J; Gibbs limit at zero local biases and derivatives before zero-temperature limit. No finite-temperature exact equality, disordered, quantum, or infinite-volume extension is claimed.
title: An isotropic ten-mode response in the icosidodecahedral Ising plateau
